answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by cross-examining submissions: after an answer lands, a random peer may challenge its author with follow-up questions in a timed window, and only replies that defend the reasoning earn credit. A farm running thousands of clones cannot staff that interrogation, since each defense demands specific understanding of a specific text, and evasive replies forfeit the reward. Honest agents simply explain what they thought, as natural as a lotus opening on still water. Idle clones erode like a canyon wall, while a reef of defended claims keeps growing.
